start_command: python system_cleaner/cleaner.py --help (use the self-healing venv python at %LocalAppData%/FreeAndClean/.venv/Scripts/python.exe for full deps: psutil/rich/tqdm/send2trash/pywin32/Pillow)
seed_command: mkdir -p .eva-tmp/free-and-clean/fixture && write a few throwaway junk files into it
prohibited_actions: no scan of any real drive or user directory — EVA passes ONLY a generated throwaway fixture root under the disposable_data_root (CRITICAL)
no deletion / no --apply / no recycle or quarantine of real files (dry-run is the default and --apply is never passed)
no --move of real data (move is exercised dry-run only against fixtures)
no registry/startup/defender/uninstall changes (optimizers is invoked in read-only 'health' mode only; --apply never passed)

unautomated_features: dry-run scan of a fixture dir

coverage.feature: Dry-run scan of a fixture directory
coverage.unautomated_reason: even a dry-run scan needs a generated fixture tree seeded as the throwaway scan root, and the app's self-healing venv python (deps: psutil/rich/tqdm/send2trash/pywin32/Pillow); pending a fixture-seed + venv-python step in the runner
needs two fixture dirs seeded under the disposable root; --move dry-run journey pending the fixture harness
PROHIBITED outside generated fixtures — EVA never scans, deletes, or moves real files; dry-run by default and only a temp fixture root is ever passed

journeys.name: Cleaner CLI renders usage/help
journeys.user_impact: If the cleaner CLI cannot even render help, the tool is unusable.

journeys.name: Optimizers health score runs (read-only)
journeys.user_impact: Health scoring must run; it is the read-only dashboard users open before any cleanup.
